title: Dominant Pentatonics and Half Diminished Chords
summary: One pentatonic shape that holds three chords, for playing over a dominant chord, and how it covers the whole neck.

helpful.why: The lesson walks the neck one shape at a time.
Step 6 shows where the rootless chords and the pentatonic sit inside it, not what the scale is.
It is why you can leave the root out of a chord.
One set of notes, several names.
